title: Patient Financial Account Terms — Closing the Financial Account
content:
**Who may close.** A patient leaving the practice may close the Patient Financial Account. The closure is requested on a billing case of the account-closure type and takes effect only when the patient confirms it.

**Zero balance.** The account's balance is 0.00 when the closure takes effect, on every financial class, since every class requires a zero balance for closure. The balance is the one the account record shows at the moment the closure would take effect.

**Before closure.** A credit is refunded first, and a balance owed is paid, or enrolled in a payment plan and paid off, first. An account on billing hold, in precollection or in collections cannot be closed.

| Account at the moment of closure | Closure takes effect on the patient's confirmation |
|---|---|
| active, balance 0.00 | yes |
| active, credit of 12.00 | no — the balance is not 0.00 |
| active, 35.00 owed | no — the balance is not 0.00 |
| on billing hold, balance 0.00 | no |
| in precollection or collections | no |

**What closure does not do.** Closing the financial account does not close the patient's medical record, cancel open referrals or prescriptions, or end a membership; each of those follows its own product line's rules.

**Q. The patient asks to close the account but has not confirmed it. Is it closed?** No. The closure takes effect only on the patient's confirmation.
